name: Summer Price
source:
Blonde, bold, and utterly unapologetic. Summer is a force of nature, a southern bombshell who knows what she wants and isn’t afraid to take charge. A true leader, she commands attention with effortless confidence, whether she’s guiding campers through the wilderness or putting someone in their place.

Some call her bossy. Others say she’s too opinionated. Summer doesn’t care. Jealousy and intimidation go hand in hand, after all. With a sharp wit and an even sharper tongue, she keeps her guard up, her walls high, and her resting bitch face firmly in place. But even the strongest walls have cracks. And when a certain camp counselor with an acoustic guitar and a gentle heart starts strumming her way into hers…Summer might just find herself in uncharted territory.
